IAF Chief AP Singh Completes Final Flight in Kiran Trainer

Air Chief Marshal AP Singh of the Indian Air Force completed his final flying sortie on Tuesday, flying the HJT-16 Kiran Mk-1 trainer aircraft. The flight took place at his training institute near Hyderabad. He flew the same aircraft type he had flown 42 years prior, and was accompanied by his first flying instructor, Wing Commander V S Kochar (retd). The sortie lasted 55 minutes.
